firm_data.firm_description: The Pickel Law Firm has helped individuals and families across Connecticut navigate the complexities of personal injury and medical malpractice law for over thirty years. The Firm has committed itself to securing justice for those who have been injured and has recovered millions of dollars for its clients.
notable_facts: Attorney Alan Scott Pickel is frequently appointed by the Connecticut Superior Court to serve as an Attorney Trial Referee, Fact Finder, Arbitrator, and Mediator.
The firm has secured multimillion-dollar settlements in complex cases.

email.subject: AI for The Pickel Law Firm, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Alan,

Over thirty years, you've recovered millions for clients across Connecticut in personal injury and medical malpractice cases. That track record comes from precision and trust, not bloated infrastructure.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in Connecticut. I'd be happy to stop by your Stamford office to share how ex-lawyers like us are helping similar firms compete without losing their edge.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
